pokedexEntries.go: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

pokedexEntries.si: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

pokedexEntries.cr: It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.

pokedexEntries.rs: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This POKéMON is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.

pokedexEntries.fr: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

pokedexEntries.lg: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

pokedexEntries.em: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.

pokedexEntries.di: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of MANTINE swimming as if they are in flight.

pokedexEntries.prl: It swims elegantly, mindless of REMORAID hitching on to its broad fins. It has a docile nature.

pokedexEntries.pt: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores REMORAID that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

pokedexEntries.hg: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

pokedexEntries.ss: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

pokedexEntries.bw: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.

pokedexEntries.x: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.

pokedexEntries.y: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

pokedexEntries.oras: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This Pokémon is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.

pokedexEntries.us: Postcards and posters featuring Mantine leaping elegantly above the waves are popular souvenirs of Alola.

pokedexEntries.um: Many people have taken up surfing because they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.

pokedexEntries.sw: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

pokedexEntries.sh: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

pokedexEntries.bd: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

pokedexEntries.shp: It swims elegantly, mindless of Remoraid hitching onto its broad fins. It is naturally docile.

pokedexEntries.la: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.
